verse.verse_1: WHEN THE SKY is cleft asunder,
verse.verse_2: And hearkens to its Lord and is dutiful,
verse.verse_3: When the earth is stretched out taut
verse.verse_4: And throws out whatever it contains and is empty,
verse.verse_5: And hearkens to its Lord and is dutiful,
verse.verse_6: O man, you have to strive and go on striving towards your Lord, then will you meet Him.
verse.verse_7: And he who is given his ledger in his right hand
verse.verse_9: And will return to his people full of joy.
verse.verse_10: But he who is given his ledger from behind his back
verse.verse_12: But will be roasted in the fire.
verse.verse_13: He lived rejoicing among his people,
verse.verse_15: Why not? His Lord was always watching him.
verse.verse_16: So indeed I call to witness the evening twilight,
verse.verse_17: And the night and all it gathers,
verse.verse_18: And the moon when at the full,
verse.verse_19: That you will climb from stage to stage.
verse.verse_20: So, wherefore do they not believe?
verse.verse_21: And when the Qur'an is recited to them do not bow in adoration?
verse.verse_23: But God knows what they harbour in their breasts.
verse.verse_24: So give them news of painful punishment,
verse.verse_25: Except those who believe and do the right: For them there is reward unending.
